policy.placement_application: none; capture already supplies world bounds in metres
policy.pair_scope: all unordered pairs of the exact 518 source identities
policy.candidate_retention: every selected-metric overlap/contact; every default-only candidate

coordinate_contract.frame: native master document saved-zero frame; complete Model ancestor chain; metres
coordinate_contract.native_mm_to_m_conversion: already performed once by captured worker; no further scaling or placements applied

interpretation.overlap_candidate: numerical boxes overlap/contact; physical collision and intended contact unknown
interpretation.omitted_pair: no selected numerical proxy overlap at saved zero; not physical clear
interpretation.default_only_candidate: default numerical boxes overlap/contact while selected optimal numerical boxes separate; no metric is accepted as physical enclosure proof
interpretation.gap: signed interval projection gap only; not exact geometric or physical clearance
